我做工具，也把难的地方写下来I build the tools, and I write down the hard parts

七个开源项目：Android 上的 Markdown 编辑器 Mdeditor、跑在 LLM 之上的确定性运行时 Intent OS、终端里的本地 Ollama 编程助手、只锁 MiniMax 一个模型的 Claude Code hook、OCR 的 MCP 服务、Windows 上的纯批处理 JDK 切换器，还有这个站本身。四篇文章写的是同一条线索：模型负责提议，代码负责裁决。Seven open-source projects: Mdeditor, a Markdown editor for Android; Intent OS, a deterministic runtime above the LLM; a local Ollama coding assistant for the terminal; a Claude Code hook that locks down MiniMax and nothing else; an OCR MCP server; a pure-batch JDK switcher for Windows; and this site. Four essays run along the same thread: the model proposes, the code decides.

作品Projects

MdeditorMdeditor

Android 上的 Markdown 编辑器：Flutter 做壳，Milkdown 做内核A Markdown editor for Android: Flutter shell, Milkdown core

在 Android 上做 Markdown 编辑器，纯 Flutter 路线意味着自己实现富文本的光标定位、选区和输入法合成，每件都是独立工程。我把编辑内核换成跑在 WebView 里的 Milkdown，Flutter 留下文件、设置、主题和导出。文档走 Android SAF，打开、编辑、保存始终指向同一个 URI。Building a Markdown editor on Android, the all-Flutter route means hand-writing caret positioning, selection and IME composition — three separate projects on their own. I moved the editing core into Milkdown inside a WebView and left Flutter with files, settings, theme and export. Documents go through Android SAF, so open, edit and save keep pointing at the same URI.

Intent OSIntent OS

把意图编译成可验收、可追溯的执行链Compiling intent into chains you can accept and audit

它不是 agent，也不是又一个 agent 框架，而是跑在 LLM 之上的确定性一层。意图先编译成带验收标准的 Plan DAG，有副作用的节点要过审批闸门，每次执行写一条哈希链回执。底下换成哪个 agent，这一层不动。Not an agent, and not another agent framework — a deterministic layer above the LLM. Intent compiles into a Plan DAG whose nodes carry acceptance criteria, side effects pass an approval gate, and every run leaves a hash-chained receipt. Swap the agent underneath; this layer stays.

Local Ollama HarnessLocal Ollama Harness

终端里的本地代码助手，裁决权不在模型手上A local coding assistant in your terminal, with the verdict taken off the model

用一句自然语言让它在 sandbox 里创建、修改并运行 Python 文件。模型只连本机 Ollama，默认 qwen2.5-coder:3b，全程离线。3B 模型靠不住，所以裁决权交给 harness：写完必验、验证后收尾、重复动作强停、路径越界直接拒绝。Create, edit and run Python files inside a sandbox from a plain-language prompt. It talks only to a local Ollama (qwen2.5-coder:3b by default), so it works offline. A 3B model is not dependable, so the harness keeps the verdict: verify after writing, finish after verifying, hard-stop on repeats, refuse any path outside the sandbox.

MiniMax LockdownMiniMax Lockdown

只给一个不太可信的模型造笼子A cage for one model I don't fully trust

一组 Claude Code 的 PreToolUse / PostToolUse hook，只在当前模型是 MiniMax 时才启动：rm、mv、改注册表、碰 ~/.ssh 和 ~/.aws 一律硬拒绝；git clone、wget 这类不常见下载弹窗问人；剩下的灰区交给独立审计模型，它回 verdict、confidence 和 severity。别的模型一律 exit 0，零开销。A pair of Claude Code PreToolUse / PostToolUse hooks that only engage when the active model is MiniMax. rm, mv, registry edits and anything touching ~/.ssh or ~/.aws are hard-denied; uncommon downloads like git clone or wget raise a prompt; the gray zone goes to a separate auditor model that answers with a verdict, a confidence and a severity. Any other model exits 0 at once.

OCR MCPOCR MCP

给 agent 用的 OCR 工具服务OCR as an MCP service for agents

基于 PaddleOCR 的 MCP stdio server，四件工具：文字、表格、手写、公式。公式直接输出 LaTeX，表格输出结构化文本，中英日韩都能认，默认中文。输入收本地路径和 HTTP(S) URL，pip install 之后就能挂进 Claude Desktop。A PaddleOCR-backed MCP server on stdio with four tools: text, tables, handwriting and formulas. Formulas come back as LaTeX, tables as structured text, and it reads Chinese, English, Japanese and Korean with Chinese as the default. Inputs are local paths or HTTP(S) URLs, and one pip install plugs it into Claude Desktop.

JEnv for WindowsJEnv for Windows

纯批处理实现的 JDK 切换器A JDK switcher written in pure batch

一个 java.bat 垫片挡在 PATH 前面，把它转发到你选中的 JDK。同一终端里两个项目可以跑在两套 JDK 上。JAVA_HOME 永远指向 JEnv 目录，jenv use 和 jenv local 立刻对读环境变量的工具生效。附带一个只读 MCP server，让 agent 也能查当前 JDK。A java.bat shim sits in front of java on PATH and forwards it to the JDK you picked, so two projects in one terminal can run on two JDKs. JAVA_HOME always points at the JEnv directory, which means jenv use and jenv local take effect immediately for tools that read the environment. A read-only MCP server lets an agent ask which JDK is active.

linuxlinking.github.iolinuxlinking.github.io

你现在看到的这个站The site you are looking at

手写的静态站：原生 HTML、CSS 和 ES module，一个零依赖的 Python 脚本组装，没有框架、没有 CDN、没有网络字体。桌面是 Windows XP，每个窗口是一个 IE6，但页面在构建期就渲染好了，关掉 JavaScript 也能读完。A hand-written static site: native HTML, CSS and ES modules, assembled by a dependency-free Python script. No framework, no CDN, no web fonts. The desktop is Windows XP and every window is an IE6 shell, but the pages are rendered at build time, so the whole thing still reads with JavaScript switched off.

文字Writing

本地 Ollama 编程 Agent：不信 3B 模型，把守卫写成代码Ollama Coding Agent, Distrust the 3B Model, Encode the Guard

qwen2.5-coder:3b 写完文件就宣布「退出码 0」，其实什么都没跑。Local Ollama Harness 把每一种失败模式写成守卫里的一条确定性规则：模型只提议，裁决权在 harness。A 3B model wrote the file, announced exit code 0, and had run nothing. Local Ollama Harness turns each failure mode into one guard rule: the model proposes, the harness disposes.

为什么我不做 Agent 框架，而做一层 RuntimeWhy a Runtime, Not Another Agent Framework

每个 agent 框架最终都会撞上同一堵墙。Intent OS 的回答是不做第八十个框架：意图编译成带验收标准的计划，副作用过审批闸门，回执进哈希链。Every agent harness hits the same wall. Intent OS is not the 80th framework: intent compiles into a plan with acceptance criteria, side effects are gated, receipts are hash-chained.

把 Milkdown 塞进 WebView：混血编辑器的取舍与代价Milkdown in a WebView: What a Hybrid Editor Costs

Flutter 做壳，WebView 里跑 Milkdown，中间一条 JS 桥——不是偷懒，是取舍。单一桥协议、SAF URI 持久化、手写 OOXML、主题单向流，四个决定各有一笔账。A Flutter shell, Milkdown in a WebView, one JS bridge between them: a deliberate trade, not a shortcut. One bridge protocol, persisted SAF URIs, hand-rolled OOXML, one-way theming.

给不可信的模型造笼子：Claude Code Hook 与 LLM 安全A Cage for One Untrusted Model: A Claude Code Hook for LLM Security

代码管必然，人管例外，模型管灰区——三层防线只锁 Claude Code 里那个 MiniMax：换任何别的模型，这套笼子零开销。Code handles the certain, humans handle the exceptions, a model handles the gray zone: three layers lock down MiniMax inside Claude Code, and no other model.
